name: Dark Roll 2
description:
About This Game

The darkest ball-rolling adventure returns!

Dark Roll 2 is a dark fantasy 3D platformer inspired by soulslike genre. You’ll take on a series of uniquely designed levels packed with precision platforming, deadly traps, and unforgiving environmental hazards that test your agility, logic, perseverance, and sanity.

Roll your way through a variety of worlds, each introducing new mechanics and challenges. Navigate treacherous terrain, avoid lethal obstacles, and uncover clever solutions as you collect gems, solve puzzles, and overcome enemies on your way to the exit.

Prove your skill by completing time challenges and competing with other players on the Steam Leaderboards. Push yourself even further by unlocking Steam achievements designed to extend the challenge of Dark Roll 2.

Master precise movement, survive brutal challenges, and prove your skill in a world designed to test even the most determined players.

FEATURES

  • Physics-based rolling that rewards mastery and precision

  • Deadly traps and environmental hazards that punish mistakes

  • Three difficulty levels that adapt to your skill level

  • Diverse worlds that change both in style and the challenges they present

  • Unlockable skins for your orb

  • Additional time challenges for every level

  • Steam Leaderboards to compete against other players’ scores

  • Steam Achievements that extend gameplay with additional challenges
short_desc: A Souls-like inspired 3D platformer built around physics-based rolling, where every mistake can send you tumbling into danger. You’ll take on a series of uniquely designed levels packed with unforgiving environmental hazards that test your agility, logic, perseverance, and sanity.
